_note: Approximate Ottoman extents traced from town conquest dates (Söğüt/Bilecik/İnegöl/Yenişehir 1299-1300; Bursa 1326; Nicaea 1331; Nicomedia 1337; Karesi c. 1345; Thrace/Plovdiv 1360s; Serres 1383; Sofia 1385; Niš 1386; Thessaloniki 1387; Kütahya 1381; Hamid lands 1374/81; Ankara 1354/61). Reference maps: Shepherd, Historical Atlas (1911), 'The Byzantine Empire and the Ottoman Turks in 1355'; historical-basemaps world_1400. Shown on screen as approx.

c1400.note: Before Ankara: Balkans to the Danube (Bulgaria annexed 1393-96, Thessaly c.1393-96); Anatolia incl. Aydin/Saruhan/Mentese/Germiyan/Hamid/Teke (1390), Karaman (1397), Kastamonu (1392), Sivas (1398), Malatya (1399); excl. Sinop (Candar), Trebizond, Cilicia/Dulkadir (Mamluk sphere). Hand-traced, approx.

1403.note: After Timur's settlement: beyliks restored (Karaman, Germiyan, Aydin, Saruhan, Mentese, Hamid/Teke, Candar); Ottomans keep Rumelia (Suleyman) and NW Anatolia (Bursa, Iznik, Karesi), Mehmed Celebi around Amasya/Tokat. Hand-traced, approx.

1451.note: c.1451 (Mehmed II's accession): Balkans to the Danube incl. Thessaly, Thessaloniki (1430), Skopje; Serbian Despotate and Wallachia vassals (not filled); Anatolia incl. Aydin, Saruhan, Mentese, Germiyan, Hamid, Teke, Amasya/Tokat, Samsun, Ankara; excl. Karaman, Candar (Kastamonu/Sinop), Trebizond, Dulkadir. Byzantium: Constantinople + Morea (+ small towns/islands not drawn). Hand-traced, approx.

1512.note: Accession of Selim I: Balkans incl. Greece/Morea, Albania, Bosnia, Herzegovina, Serbia (Belgrade still Hungarian), Bulgaria, Dobruja to the Danube delta; Anatolia incl. Karaman and Trebizond, excl. Dulkadir/Ramazanid lands (Mamluk vassals) and the east beyond Erzincan. Wallachia, Moldavia, Crimea vassals (not filled). Hand-traced, approx.

1520.note: Death of Selim I: + eastern Anatolia (Erzincan, Diyarbakir, Mardin), Dulkadir, Syria, Palestine, Egypt, the Hejaz (sovereignty over Mecca/Medina). Hand-traced, approx.

1530.note: After Suleiman's first campaigns: 1520 lands + Belgrade and Syrmia (1521), Rhodes (1522-23); John Zapolya's Hungary an Ottoman vassal (1529, faint). Habsburg (Royal) Hungary in the west/north not Ottoman. Hand-traced, approx.

1566.note: Death of Suleiman I: 1530 lands + Baghdad/Iraq (1534-35, Basra 1546), Erzurum, Van (1548); central Hungary (Buda 1541, Temesvar 1552); Tripoli (1551); Regency of Algiers; Yemen/Aden. Vassals (faint): Transylvania, Wallachia, Moldavia, Crimea. Hand-traced, approx.

1540.note: Mediterranean after the 1537-40 war: 1530 lands + Regency of Algiers (Ottoman province) + Nauplion, Monemvasia and Venetian Aegean islands ceded in 1540 (islands region approx.). Venice keeps Crete, Cyprus, Corfu. Hand-traced, approx.

1570.note: Before Lepanto: 1566 lands + 1540 Aegean/Morea gains. Venice keeps Cyprus, Crete, Corfu. Hand-traced, approx.

1573.note: After the 1573 peace: + Cyprus. Venice keeps Crete, Corfu. Hand-traced, approx.

1730.note: Under Mahmud I, before 1739: Balkans without Belgrade/northern Serbia (Austrian 1718-39), Morea regained 1715, Crete (1669), Cyprus, Aegean; Anatolia, Iraq, Syria, Egypt, Hejaz (Yemen lost 1635); North African regencies (Algiers, Tunis, Tripoli) largely autonomous (faint). Hand-traced, approx.

1739.note: After the Treaty of Belgrade (1739): + Belgrade and northern Serbia. Hand-traced, approx.

1683.note: Before Vienna 1683: Ottoman Hungary (Buda, Temesvar, Eger, Kanizsa, Varad, Uyvar), Podolia (1672), Crete (1669), Cyprus; Iraq; Egypt; Yemen lost (1635). Vassals: Transylvania, Wallachia, Moldavia, Crimea (Transylvania drawn faint). Hand-traced, approx.

1699.note: Treaty of Karlowitz (26 Jan 1699): lost Hungary (kept the Banat of Temesvar and Belgrade), Podolia to Poland, the Morea to Venice; Transylvania to Habsburg control. Hand-traced, approx.

1826.note: 1826: Balkans to the Danube (Belgrade garrisoned; Serbia autonomous de facto, Greece in revolt since 1821); Anatolia, Iraq, Syria; Egypt under Muhammad Ali (autonomous, faint); Crete, Cyprus, Aegean. Crimea (1783) and Bessarabia (1812) already Russian. Hand-traced, approx.

1830.note: 1830: Greece independent (London Protocol, Feb 1830; frontier approx.), Serbia autonomous principality (faint). Hand-traced, approx.

1839.note: 1839 (Gulhane edict): as 1830; Egypt under Muhammad Ali autonomous; Serbia autonomous. Hand-traced, approx.

1878.note: After the Congress of Berlin (1878): Romania, Serbia, Montenegro independent; Bulgaria autonomous principality + Eastern Rumelia (faint); Bosnia-Herzegovina occupied by Austria-Hungary; Cyprus under British administration; Kars, Ardahan, Batum to Russia (east edge not redrawn). Thessaly still Ottoman until 1881. Hand-traced, approx.

1914.note: 1914 (entry into WWI): after the Balkan Wars, Eastern Thrace only (Enez-Midye line); Anatolia (Kars/Batum Russian since 1878); Iraq; Syria, Palestine, the Hejaz strip, Yemen. Libya (1912), Egypt (British), Cyprus, Crete, Dodecanese already lost. Hand-traced, approx.

1918.note: Armistice of Mudros (30 Oct 1918): Anatolia, Eastern Thrace, Mosul region; Arab lands lost. Outline from modern Turkey (Natural Earth) + Mosul, approx.

1923.note: Treaty of Lausanne (24 Jul 1923): Republic of Turkey. Modern Natural Earth outline (Hatay joined only in 1939; Mosul settled 1926). Approx.
